boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named campus spaces for studying, gathering, arts, reflection, and small-group conversation, supported by current Fairfield University sources.

cards.title: DiMenna-Nyselius Library
cards.subtitle: Three-floor library with rooms and open work space
cards.notes: Reserve a room for a project session, or use the open work areas when you need a change from a residence-hall desk.
cards.short_summary: A campus library with small meeting rooms, computer labs, and open work space.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield describes the library as having conference rooms, computer labs, six smaller meeting rooms, and open work space across three floors.
cards.source_title: The DiMenna-Nyselius Library | Fairfield University
cards.access_notes: Use the library's current hours and room-reservation information before visiting.

cards.title: Barone Campus Center
cards.subtitle: Campus hub with lobby, meeting rooms, and mezzanine
cards.notes: Use the lower-level lobby as a meetup point before an event, then check the building schedule for an open meeting space.
cards.short_summary: A central campus building configured for gatherings and meetings.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield calls the Barone Campus Center the central hub for the university community and identifies its lobby, meeting rooms, and mezzanine.
cards.source_title: Available Rooms | Fairfield University
cards.access_notes: Rooms and event areas may be reserved; confirm availability with the building or event schedule.

cards.entity_name: Regina A. Quick Center for the Arts
cards.title: Regina A. Quick Center for the Arts
cards.subtitle: Campus venue for performances, lectures, and exhibitions
cards.notes: Browse the calendar with friends and choose a performance, lecture, or exhibit that fits your schedule; ticket terms vary by event.
cards.short_summary: A multi-venue arts center that hosts campus and community programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield says the Quick Center hosts performances, lectures, exhibits, and other creative and educational events.
cards.source_title: Quick Center for the Arts | Fairfield University
cards.access_notes: Check the Quick Center calendar and individual event details before attending.

cards.title: Wien Experimental Theatre
cards.subtitle: Black-box theatre inside the Quick Center
cards.notes: Look for Theatre Fairfield productions and take in a performance in the flexible black-box space; confirm ticketing and entry details first.
cards.short_summary: The Quick Center's black-box theatre and home to Theatre Fairfield.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield identifies the Wien Experimental Theatre as the home of Theatre Fairfield and describes it as a flexible 40-by-40-foot black-box theatre.
cards.source_title: Theatre | Fairfield University
cards.access_notes: Performance access depends on the production; consult the event listing before you go.

cards.title: Thomas J. Walsh Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Fairfield University Art Museum gallery in the Quick Center
cards.notes: Pair a gallery visit with time at the Quick Center, and check the museum's exhibition information before heading over.
cards.short_summary: One of the Fairfield University Art Museum's two named gallery locations.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield states that the Thomas J. Walsh Art Gallery is in the Quick Center and is part of the Fairfield University Art Museum.
cards.source_title: Resources and Services | Fairfield University
cards.access_notes: Museum hours apply; the museum states that gallery admission is free and reservations are not required.

cards.title: Bellarmine Hall Gallery
cards.subtitle: Fairfield University Art Museum gallery in Bellarmine Hall
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition, then make time for the Bellarmine Hall gallery during published museum hours.
cards.short_summary: A museum gallery located in Bellarmine Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield identifies the Bellarmine Hall Gallery as one of the Fairfield University Art Museum's gallery locations.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Fairfield University Art Museum
cards.access_notes: The museum lists Bellarmine Hall Gallery hours and says admission is always free with no reservation required.

cards.entity_name: Egan Chapel of St. Ignatius Loyola
cards.title: Egan Chapel of St. Ignatius Loyola
cards.subtitle: Campus Ministry center and worship space
cards.notes: Stop by for a quiet reset or join a listed service; Campus Ministry also offers multifaith programming and student support.
cards.short_summary: A central chapel with Campus Ministry spaces on its lower level.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield says Campus Ministry is located in the lower level of Egan Chapel and that its spaces are open to students daily from 6 a.m. to midnight.
cards.source_title: Our Staff | Fairfield University Campus Ministry
cards.access_notes: Campus Ministry spaces are listed as open to students from 6 a.m. to midnight daily; worship services follow their own schedule.

cards.title: Dolan Hall Chapel
cards.subtitle: Small chapel and meeting area near the townhouses
cards.notes: Use this smaller setting for a scheduled discussion, presentation, or reflection time; confirm the room is not reserved first.
cards.short_summary: A small, named campus chapel with seating and presentation capability.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield describes Dolan Hall Chapel as a small meeting area near the townhouses for celebrations, discussions, and presentations.
cards.source_title: Dolan Hall Chapel | Fairfield University
cards.access_notes: This is an event-capable room; check with Conference and Event Management before planning a gathering.

cards.title: Bellarmine Hall
cards.subtitle: Historic campus building with the Great Hall and museum gallery
cards.notes: Walk through during an open period to see the building's wood-paneled Great Hall, then combine the stop with the gallery nearby.
cards.short_summary: A 1927 campus building with smaller gathering spaces and a museum gallery.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield says Bellarmine Hall was built in 1927 and contains the Great Hall and the George C. Diffley Board Room for smaller meetings or receptions.
cards.source_title: Bellarmine Hall | Fairfield University
cards.access_notes: Interior spaces may be in use for meetings or events; respect posted access and reservations.

cards.title: Examen Statue of St. Ignatius
cards.subtitle: Outside Egan Chapel of St. Ignatius Loyola
cards.notes: Pause at the statue outside Egan Chapel as a waypoint before or after a campus walk, keeping paths and active services clear.
cards.short_summary: A named St. Ignatius statue situated outside Egan Chapel.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield's university overview identifies the Examen statue of St. Ignatius as being outside Egan Chapel.
cards.source_title: About Fairfield | Fairfield University
cards.access_notes: This is an outdoor campus landmark; follow campus access guidance and avoid interrupting chapel services.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented Fairfield study environments spanning quiet work, group collaboration, research support, and technology-enabled work.

cards.title: DiMenna-Nyselius Library
cards.subtitle: Fairfield’s academic-resource hub
cards.notes: Start here when you need research materials, librarians, or a choice of quiet, group, meeting, and collaboration settings in one building.
cards.short_summary: The central library building for research and several types of academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield identifies DiMenna-Nyselius Library as home to research materials, librarians, study spaces, and academic resources.
cards.source_title: Academic Support | Fairfield University
cards.access_notes: Study and collaboration spaces are primarily for Fairfield students, faculty, and staff.

cards.title: Library Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Reservable rooms in DiMenna-Nyselius Library
cards.notes: Reserve a room for a focused session with your group; bring devices and use the provided whiteboard, wireless internet, power, and seating.
cards.short_summary: Reservable group-study rooms with practical work surfaces and connectivity.
cards.evidence_claim: The Library lists 16 study rooms with comfortable seating, whiteboards, wireless internet, and power; users may reserve up to two hours daily.
cards.source_title: Reserve a Room | Fairfield University Library
cards.access_notes: For students; reservation maximum is two hours per user per day.

cards.title: Library Collaboratories
cards.subtitle: Drop-in collaborative work spaces
cards.notes: Use a Collaboratory when your project needs shared discussion rather than a reservation; these spaces are intended for drop-in collaborative work.
cards.short_summary: First-come collaborative spaces for group work.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield lists 10 Collaboratory spaces that are first come, first serve and not reservable.
cards.source_title: Reserve a Room | Fairfield University Library
cards.access_notes: First come, first serve; not reservable.

cards.title: Fredrickson Family CAS Innovation Lab
cards.subtitle: Drop-in technology-enabled study space
cards.notes: Check whether classes or events are scheduled, then use the mobile workstations, HDTV screens, specialized software, and seminar-room setting.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 StagCard-accessible lab for technology-supported work.
cards.evidence_claim: The Innovation Lab is a drop-in study space when unscheduled, accessible 24/7 by StagCard swipe, with mobile workstations and HDTV screens.
cards.source_title: Reserve a Room | Fairfield University Library
cards.access_notes: Available for drop-in study when no class or event is scheduled; 24/7 access requires StagCard swipe.

cards.title: Weil Café
cards.subtitle: DiMenna-Nyselius Library café seating area
cards.notes: Use the café seating area for a late research session; the University lists it as a 24/7 study space with desktop computers and charging access.
cards.short_summary: A library café-area study setting with around-the-clock study access.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield’s catalog states that 24/7 study space is available in the Weil Café and notes library equipment including printers and charging resources.
cards.source_title: Resources and Services | Fairfield University Graduate Catalog
cards.access_notes: Listed as a 24/7 study space; check Library hours and access updates before visiting.

cards.title: Quiet Study Room
cards.subtitle: DiMenna-Nyselius Library lower level
cards.notes: Choose this named room when you want a quiet library setting; it is documented as one of the Library’s drop-in study spaces.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet, drop-in study room in the library.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield’s 2024–25 Fact Book identifies a Quiet Study Room among the Library’s drop-in study spaces.
cards.source_title: 2024–2025 Fact Book | Fairfield University
cards.access_notes: Located in DiMenna-Nyselius Library; library building-use policies apply.

cards.title: Graduate Student Study Area
cards.subtitle: DiMenna-Nyselius Library lower level
cards.notes: Graduate students can use this designated lower-level area when they want a library-based place to read, write, or prepare research.
cards.short_summary: A library area specifically designated for graduate student study.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield’s library access update identifies a Graduate Student Study Area on the lower level of DiMenna-Nyselius Library.
cards.source_title: Access to Library Resources & Services | The DNL Report
cards.access_notes: Located on the library lower level; confirm current building access through Library hours.

cards.title: Virtual Reality Room
cards.subtitle: Reservable DiMenna-Nyselius Library room
cards.notes: Reserve this named room when your group needs an enclosed study setting; the University identifies one reservable study room with virtual-reality equipment.
cards.short_summary: A reservable library study room associated with virtual-reality equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield’s 2024–25 Fact Book states that the Library has 15 reservable study rooms, including one with virtual-reality equipment.
cards.source_title: 2024–2025 Fact Book | Fairfield University
cards.access_notes: Reserve through Library room-reservation procedures; availability is subject to booking.

cards.title: Writing Center
cards.subtitle: NYS 218, DiMenna-Nyselius Library main floor
cards.notes: Book an individual session when drafting or revising; peer tutors work collaboratively on writing at any point in the writing process.
cards.short_summary: A library-based peer-tutoring destination for writing projects.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield states that the Writing Center is in NYS 218 on the Library’s main floor and offers individual in-person and virtual peer tutoring.
cards.source_title: Writing, Math & Science Centers | Fairfield University
cards.access_notes: Undergraduate and graduate students of any major may visit; appointments are limited to one session per day.

cards.title: Mathematics Center
cards.subtitle: NYS 217, DiMenna-Nyselius Library main floor
cards.notes: Use drop-in tutoring or schedule one-on-one help for Precalculus, Calculus, or Statistics when you need to work through first-year core math.
cards.short_summary: A library-based tutoring destination for foundational math coursework.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield states that the Mathematics Center in NYS 217 offers free drop-in and one-on-one tutoring for first-year core math classes.
cards.source_title: Writing, Math & Science Centers | Fairfield University
cards.access_notes: For Fairfield students; consult the Center for current drop-in and appointment availability.
